behaviors.statement: Relationship scoring is asymmetric: a directed signal changes score(A->B) without changing score(B->A).
Every signal contributes exactly its bucket weight (1, 2 or 3) or zero. No partial firings, no learned weights.
The status-gradient signal S8 cannot fire unless a substrate signal (S3, S5, S6 or S7) has already fired; prominence breaks ties but never creates a match.

A match surfaces on substance: at least one of S3/S5/S6/S7 fired. There is no default points floor (removed 2026-09-04); a configured surface_min_score is evaluated over S1-S7 with S8 and S9 excluded. Otherwise the Room block reports no strong match rather than forcing one.
The rendered card body is 250-350 words. Outside the band is a hard gate failure.
The card has exactly five ordered bare-noun blocks: Who, Now, Room, Notice, Say. The last block is a sayable line, not a fact.
Every fact rendered on the card carries resolvable provenance. A fact with no source cannot render.
An inferred fact must name the facts it was composed from, or it cannot render.
A stale profile degrades honestly: the Now block states the trail is cold rather than presenting old material as current or fabricating recency.

Adapters are tiered GREEN / METERED / SESSION. A SESSION adapter never runs in the deployed runtime; an unavailable adapter reports unavailability and returns empty, and is never fabricated or silently substituted.
Ranking is deterministic: ties break by LARGE-signal count, then evidence recency, then member id.
The reason sentence names only signals that actually fired.
An empty room produces a valid card with an honest Room block, not an error and not a fabricated match.
Digest generation is idempotent: the same arrival against the same roster and cache yields the same card.
Evaluation gates on structure and grades on content: gate failures fail the digest outright; content quality is scored with partial credit.
A session that expires mid-ingest yields a partial profile that is marked partial; already-collected facts are kept and the gap is reported.
Session-assisted adapters expose read operations only. No write operation exists in the adapter interface, so posting, messaging, liking or following is unreachable.
Session adapters extract only whitelisted member-owned fields; personalized strings about the operator's own graph are dropped at the boundary and never enter a fact record.
A topic whose holder share over the member base is >= 0.40 is non-discriminating and excluded from the topic signals S5/S6, room-independent.
A supplied arrival label that is out of date is corrected and shown to the host, never echoed as fact.
Recency has three states; only `quiet` may state silence, and one unreached source downgrades the profile to `unknown`.
third_party_open content is never attributed, never rendered, and never reaches the narrator as fact.
Withheld facts are reported as class and count only, never as content.
The intent-complement signal S9 fires only when the pair's intent class is complement; it is added to the displayed score and fired signals but never to the surfacing floor.
